backgroundPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: reusable background for landscape Google Play screenshot graphics, 1920 x 1080 pixels, 16:9.
Create an elegant quiet dark oxblood burgundy background, very subtle woven paper texture, restrained warm gold thin flowing rhythm lines only in the top-right corner and extreme edges. Match a traditional lion dance percussion app's dark burgundy and muted gold color scheme. Large uncluttered plain dark-burgundy areas everywhere, especially upper-left and across the lower three quarters, for later typesetting and compositing authentic app screenshots. Sophisticated restrained graphic design, excellent contrast for cream text. No text or letters, no symbols, no instruments, no people, no lion/dragon illustration, no phone or device frames, no UI, no watermark. Full bleed, opaque, square corners.
screenshots: Original user-provided screenshots composited without changing UI; scaled proportionally without cropping.
localization: Vietnamese captions are typeset using the existing export script. Original screenshots retain their captured interface language.
